inventory.name: [NopalCyber] Unmasking MonsterV2 Behavioral Detection – ClickFix Campaign

properties.description: Detects potential TA585 / MonsterV2 command-and-control (C2) behavior linked to the ClickFix campaign. This rule identifies hosts that first contact api.ipify.org (used by malware to determine external IP) and subsequently connect to a non-private IP on port 7712 or known TA585 C2 infrastructure, indicating possible beaconing activity after initial reconnaissance.
properties.displayName: [NopalCyber] Unmasking MonsterV2 Behavioral Detection – ClickFix Campaign
properties.query:
let Lookback = 3d;
let PreC2Behaviour =
    DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
    | where RemoteUrl has "api.ipify.org"
    | distinct DeviceName;
let TA585_C2_IPs = dynamic([
    "139.180.160.173",
    "155.138.150.12",
    "83.217.208.77",
    "91.200.14.69",
    "212.102.255.102",
    "84.200.154.105",
    "144.172.117.158",
    "109.120.137.128",
    "84.200.17.240",
    "84.200.77.213",
    "79.133.51.100"
]);
DeviceNetworkEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
| where RemoteIP in (TA585_C2_IPs) and RemotePort == 7712
| where DeviceName in (PreC2Behaviour)
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, RemoteIP, RemotePort, RemoteUrl, LocalIP, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessSHA256, InitiatingProcessAccountUpn, DeviceId, ReportId
